mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", author_name AS "authorName", content AS "content", is_prompt AS "isPrompt", to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" FROM blog_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY is_prompt DESC, created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_comment (post_id, author_name, password_hash, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorName}, #{passwordHash}, #{content})
INSERT INTO blog_comment (post_id, author_name, content, is_prompt) VALUES (#{postId}, #{authorName}, #{content}, TRUE) ON CONFLICT (post_id) WHERE is_prompt DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", password_hash AS "passwordHash" FROM blog_comment WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_comment SET deleted_at = now() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
